About Wayang AI

Our Mission

Wayang AI is building the future of intelligent automation. We believe that AI agents should work together seamlessly, just like a well-orchestrated team, to solve complex problems and automate workflows.

What is Wayang?

“Wayang” comes from the traditional Indonesian puppet theater, where a master puppeteer (dalang) orchestrates multiple characters to tell compelling stories. Similarly, our platform enables you to orchestrate multiple AI agents to accomplish complex tasks.

Wayang Assistant

Wayang includes an internal assistant that helps users build projects, answer questions about Wayang, and troubleshoot errors using official documentation. See Wayang Assistant docs.

The Vision

We envision a world where:

  • AI agents collaborate seamlessly to achieve complex goals
  • Developers focus on creativity rather than infrastructure
  • Automation is accessible to everyone, not just AI experts
  • Intelligent workflows adapt and learn from experience

Core Values

🔓 Open Source First

Wayang AI is built on open-source principles. We believe in transparency, community collaboration, and giving back to the developer ecosystem.

🎯 Developer Experience

Great tools should be intuitive. We prioritize clean APIs, comprehensive documentation, and delightful developer experiences.

🔒 Security & Privacy

Your data and workflows are sensitive. We build security into every layer of our platform and respect your privacy.

🌍 Global Community

AI innovation happens everywhere. We’re building a global community of developers, researchers, and enthusiasts.

Technology Stack

Wayang AI is built with modern, battle-tested technologies:

Layer Technology
Runtime Node.js, TypeScript
Workflow Engine Custom event-driven architecture
AI Integration LangChain, LlamaIndex
Storage PostgreSQL, Redis
API REST, GraphQL
UI React, TypeScript
Deployment Docker, Kubernetes

The Team

Wayang AI is developed by a passionate team of engineers, researchers, and AI enthusiasts from around the world.
